comments.body: CODE-REVIEW GERRIT DATA LIMITATION: bot posts findings in review MESSAGES not inline comments (0 inline). 282 bot msgs: 266 pass+1 (only report advisory COUNT, not criterion/priority), 5 block-finding (~all DET secret-detection), 5 coverage-gap vetoes, 1 old-format detailed. => code-review has NO per-criterion priority history to replay; only block-rate + nit-volume. To assess code-review LLM thresholds need live re-run of gate on sampled diffs OR accept statistical/historical argument. Plan-review CAN be replayed (rich sidecars w/ priority+validity+norm_id).

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
PLAN-REVIEW ROBUST FINDINGS (corpus 681/251/9792): (1) all would-block findings (priority>=0.70) are verifier-confirmed high-validity (mVal 0.97-1.00) + high-impact (0.78-0.83) => NOT nits/FPs; verifier is the adjudicator. (2) 0.70-0.75 is the reliability sweet spot: minimizes verdict-FLIP on identical code (5.1% all re-reviews / ~42% near-boundary, n small); BOTH lower (0.60=13.9%) and higher (0.80-0.90=86% near) flip MORE (rarer high-priority findings less reproducible). VINDICATES prior 0.70 choice. (3) The naive re-run of calibrate_plan_review_thresholds.py demotes all 7 (rev_rr<0.6) but that's a FINDER-CHURN ARTIFACT (norm_id only ~41% stable on identical code; per-finding actioned signal unreliable). (4) Replay 97.9% faithful to recorded verdicts. (5) Trustworthy per-crit repro (n>=8): T8 85%(adv,n20), E2 62%, G6 50%(workhorse,127 blocks), T3 33%, T1 22%. T8 is best-reproducing but advisory; promoting doubles flip + agents ignore it. T5e/T4/G5 repro n=1 => can't act. CONCLUSION leaning: KEEP blocking-7@0.70; real limiter is finder non-determinism (needs N-sample corroboration, not threshold change). Block-rate ~19-24% of reviews.
CODE-REVIEW: running live evals (recall/false-accept/kappa per criterion) + 6 parallel live diff re-runs for priority distribution + adjudication of plan-review blocks. Historical: LLM blocks ~never, only DET secrets; nit vol 5/review.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body: PLAN-REVIEW ADJUDICATION (13 would-block findings, held-out judge): 5 VALID-BLOCK, 7 BORDERLINE, 1 NIT, 0 FALSE-POSITIVE. Verifier validity is EARNED (no hallucinations) but gate OVER-BLOCKS: only ~5/13 truly block-worthy. Block-worthy ones = CODE-GROUNDED wrong-work-preventing defects (fail-closed blast radius, phantom-config-vs-precedent, unimplementable detector, codebase-unsupported pipeline, undecomposed giant epic). The ~8 borderline/nit = PROCESS/COMPLETENESS archetypes (add-ADR, add-rollback-flag, decompose-cohesive-story, specify-config-format, tidy-AC) that inherit critical severity & clear 0.70 w/o preventing wrong work. Systematic: (1) 'accurate+critical-severity' != 'block-worthy'; (2) G5 decomposition fires same on epics(valid) & cohesive stories(over-eager) w/o altitude adjust. G6=strongest blocker (code-grounded). REFRAME: numeric 0.70 is fine (0 FP, flip-optimal); real lever = per-criterion POSTURE (demote process-heavy criteria, keep code-grounded). Running LARGER per-criterion adjudication to get block-worthy rates.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
FINAL EVIDENCE (both gates).
CODE-REVIEW live re-runs (6 real merged diffs, current gate/prompts): 31 LLM findings, all validity=1.0, IMPACT low-moderate => priority min0.19/p50 0.41/mean0.44/MAX 0.67. would-block @0.70 = ZERO; @0.60 = 2/31. So LLM code-review blocking at any responsible bar (>=0.70) is a NO-OP; lowering to ~0.58 would block moderate-impact maintainability/tests/docs coaching (the class adjudication says keep advisory). Verdict=BLOCK on all 6 was a LOCAL artifact (DET secret/high-crit detectors timed out -> fail-closed-abstain; they have time on server). Eval (runs=1 smoke): code-review-security recall0.857 FA0.000 kappa0.833 (safe-looking) but security findings didn't even fire on the 6 diffs, and DET high-critical-security already covers that class. CONCLUSION code-review: KEEP all 13 LLM advisory; only DET secret-detection+high-critical-security block (status quo). Introducing LLM blocking unwarranted.
PLAN-REVIEW adjudication rollup (47 would-block findings across 2 rounds): block-worthy% = G6 88%, COH 20%, T5e 20%, E2 ~12%, G5 0%(+FP), T4 0%, F1 0%. Only G6(approach-soundness, code-grounded) reliably block-worthy; rest = accurate process/completeness coaching (specify-mechanism/decompose-story/add-rollback/add-ADR) better as advisory. G5 has epic-vs-story altitude bug + an outright FP. PROPOSAL plan-review: KEEP G6 blocking@0.70 (flip-optimal, 88% precise); DEMOTE E2,G5,T4,COH,F1,T5e -> advisory@0.95. Net block-rate ~24%->~19% (G6 drives 127/148 blocks anyway); removes the low-precision process over-blocks. Numeric 0.70 stays (0 FP, minimizes verdict-flip). Root cause of over-block: 'accurate+critical-severity' != 'block-worthy'; blocking should track code-groundedness.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
ROUND-3 (post user-correction; corrected block-worthiness = guards a downstream control / high asymmetric cost, NOT code-groundedness). WITHDREW demotion proposal.
TASK2 flip-mechanism: flips are RECALL not FP. 8 flipping same-matfp pairs; decisive would-block findings validity mean 0.992 (min0.86); 14/17 flips = other run MISSED the valid finding, 3 = scored-diff. => valid findings missed, NOT FPs slipping. Lever=finder recall (validity safeguard already working). Cost-justified fix = N-sample FINDER ONLY (union, verify once) => marginal +1x finder not +1x pipeline; can gate to blocking criteria/boundary.
TASK3: 215 findings in 0.60-0.70 band on blocking criteria, all val 0.96-1.0 impact 0.67-0.70 (G6 85,T5e 40,COH 28,E2 28) — high-validity findings just under the bar; adjudicating whether block-worthy (=> lower to 0.60) or fair-advisory.
TASK4 promotion scan (would-block vol / val / impact / repro / revRR): standouts T8(194 wb,85% repro,imp0.80), codebase-grounding G1G2(imp0.80)/E4(imp0.81)/A1, T1(priorart 57pool),T3(feasibility 53pool),E1(coherence). Adjudicating block-worthiness per criterion.
TASK1 deterministic G5: ctx.children (whole child list) ALREADY loaded at orchestrator.py:166-182; pass1.py:427 already counts them. Fix: inject authoritative 'DECOMPOSITION STATE: N children [..]' into G5 finder context + DET guard vetoing a 'flat/undecomposed' G5 finding when children exist. Agent judges CONTENT not COUNT.
CODE-REVIEW evals confirm keep-advisory: perf/db-migrations/security FA=0.0 but findings impact<=0.67 (never block @>=0.70); tests FA0.17, api-compat FA0.33 (would fire on clean diffs if bar lowered). Only DET security blocks.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
SETTLED PROPOSAL.
PLAN-REVIEW threshold/posture changes (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json):
- Lower block_threshold 0.70->0.60: COH,E2,F1,G5,G6,T5e (had valid blocks in 0.6-0.7 band; band adj 15/20 block-worthy, 0 FP).
- Keep T4 @0.70 (fail-safe migrations = borderline zone).
- Promote to blocking(default_posture=blocking): G1G2@0.70, T1@0.70, T8@0.70 (100% block-worthy), E4@0.75 (0.75 excludes its lone borderline@0.716 -> 100% on sample).
- E1,T3: cannot reach 100% via threshold (borderline findings score >= valids; E1 borderline is top @0.835) -> keep advisory OR accept 75% @0.70. OPEN DECISION.
- A1 stays advisory (50%).
- Block-rate 21.1%->35.7% (36.6% if E1,T3 added). Flips 12->35 but recall-driven (addressed by finding-memory prime, Task2 approved).
- Task1 deterministic G5 child-signal: approved. Task2 Pass-1 finding-memory: approved.
- Filed idea neat-sooty-termite (c34d): rework impact aggregation (mean-of-5 dilutes high-severity below bar).
CODE-REVIEW (revised after user correction: goal=long-term maintainability not clean diff): maintainability adj of 31 findings = 7 HIGH-VALUE / 24 NIT / 0 FP. Priority CANNOT separate (landmines #10/#19 at 0.415 floor; doc-ahead nits up to 0.668) => NO threshold blocks landmines without nits. So: (a) do NOT introduce priority-threshold LLM blocking now; (b) block a semantic class 'new behavior/contract shipped without test' (DET-style, needs feasibility spike) = highest-value landmine buried at 0.415; (c) cut nit friction: docs+llm-prompts = nit-factories (0/9 high-value), down-rank/suppress esp 'doc-ahead-of-landed-sibling' pattern; (d) keep DET secret+high-crit blocking; (e) revisit priority-blocking after impact-aggregation rework. OPEN: landmine-gate approach (DET detector vs finding-class tag).
